newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR UP TO 70 PCT OF QUARRIER.
newsitem.headline: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR UP TO 70 PCT OF QUARRIER.

text.p: The Polish Treasury Ministry has invited bids for up to 70 percent of shares in open-cast quarrier Kopalnie Odkrywkowe Surowcow Drogowych Sp zoo (KOSD), the ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.

The ministry said up to 15 percent of shares would be granted to employees, at least 10 percent would go to pension funds in the reform of the state's social security system and five percent to restitution claims.
September 16 is the deadline for bids. KOSD, based in the southwestern city of Wroclaw, specialises in quarrying stones for the construction and road-building industries.
No one at the ministry was immediately available for comment.
